rationale: The short thesis remains intact as UPST continues to trade weak near the bottom of its daily range (15.2%), well below the declining session VWAP ($22.44) and 5m 9-EMA ($22.34). Recent 1-minute bounce attempts from the $22.05 low are occurring on light volume (12k-47k shares) compared to the heavy selling volume (114k shares) that established the low, indicating an orderly bearish consolidation rather than a reversal. With the broad market rising (+0.93% SPY) and UPST unable to reclaim key intraday moving averages, holding for a retest and breakdown below $22.05 remains the highest-probability path.
